title: The Crown in the Mud
text: A crown, gold and old, lies half buried in the mud of a field where some king's last battle was fought. Rusted blades and bones still break the surface all around it. It is very bright for something that has lain in mud so long.

options.label: The Leader puts on the dead king's crown, feeling it was meant to be found.

outcomes.text: It fits. It feels right. It feels like it was waiting, and that is the part that worries everyone else.
It fits. It whispers. It does not stop.

options.label: Take it to sell. A dead king has no use for gold.

outcomes.text: Gold is gold, and the dead king can have his mud.

options.label: Bury it properly with its king, and let the battle finally end.

outcomes.text: The field is quieter after, as if a long battle had finally ended, and the dead can lie down.
